chunks: Aḥmad ibn Idrīs, from al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿAbdillāh, from Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā and Muḥammad ibn ʿAbdillāh, from ʿAlī ibn Ḥadīd, from Murāzim, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

Allah, Blessed and Exalted, said: O Muḥammad, I created you and ʿAlī as light—meaning a spirit without a body—before I created My heavens, My earth, My Throne, and My sea. Then you continued declaring My Oneness and glorifying Me.

Then I gathered both of your spirits and made them one, and it was glorifying Me, declaring My holiness, and declaring My Oneness. Then I divided it into two, and divided the two into two, so they became four: Muḥammad one, ʿAlī one, and al-Ḥasan and al-Ḥusayn two. Then Allah created Fāṭimah from a light, originating her as a spirit without a body.
Then He wiped us with His right hand, so His light flowed into us.

key_terms.تُقَدِّسُنِي: declaring My holiness; exalting Allah above imperfection
key_terms.تُمَجِّدُنِي: glorifying Me; magnifying Allah in praise
key_terms.تُهَلِّلُنِي: declaring My Oneness; affirming Allah through tahlil
key_terms.رُوحًا: spirit; an immaterial mode of existence before bodily creation
key_terms.عَرْشِي: My Throne; a reference to the divine Throne among created realities
key_terms.فَأَفْضَى نُورَهُ فِينَا: His light flowed into us; indicating a special bestowal of divine light
key_terms.نُورًا: light; the primordial luminous reality in which these sacred figures were created

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about the pre-creation light of Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, ʿAlī عليه السلام, and Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the pre-eternal creation of the luminous realities of Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, ʿAlī عليه السلام, al-Ḥasan عليه السلام, al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام, and Fāṭimah عليها السلام before the creation of the heavens and the earth. It emphasizes their special ontological rank, their glorification of Allah, and their connection to divine light in a cosmological and theological framework.
